applies_why: The judge text grounds UNDERDETERMINED on the defender's recorded dropping of the curse limb, not on a single verse's failure to state a link or its contrary.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: I interpreted the rule phrase 'never a ground for ... UNDERDETERMINED' and weighed whether 'no live link remains to contradict' meant single-verse silence (forbidden) or the defender's recorded dropping of the limb (not forbidden).
why: The judge relies on the dropped limb, not on a single verse's non-statement, so K-S2 is not breached.
